summary: Inclined iPad cradle: R3 exterior and small pocket, 0.5 mm bottom chamfer, no rounding/chamfer on iPad insertion channel.

external_references.description: User marked groove location; current user intent is insertion of the iPad lower edge.

assembly_story.installation: Place the complete flat underside directly on a horizontal desktop.

designs.description: 10 degree wedge with unrounded 20 degree rearward insertion channel, nominal width 10 mm and depth 8 mm; other edges R3 except 0.5 mm bottom chamfer.
